description: Clean experimental gas-phase electron affinities for calibrating and validating the reduction-stability axis (ADR-2026-08-10). Replaces DFT/xTB LUMO as the reduction ranking target. All values are directly measured; the reference string is identical for every entry so provenance carries zero signal by construction (verified by audit_label_confound.py).
units: eV (positive = anion is bound = molecule is easily reduced)
reference: Gas-phase electron affinity, direct measurement. Compiled from Rienstra-Kiracofe, Tschumper, Schaefer, Nandi & Ellison, Chem. Rev. 2002, 102, 231-282, and the NIST Chemistry WebBook gas-phase ion energetics tables (NIST SRD 69). Only directly measured values are included: PES = photoelectron/photodetachment spectroscopy, ETE = electron-transfer equilibrium, ETS = electron transmission spectroscopy (negative EAs), ECD = electron capture detection. Values derived from computation or from empirical correlations are excluded.
